name: Phaanu
ingredients: Gahat dal (Horse gram) or Chainsoo/mixed lentils
instructions: 1. Soak the Gahat or mixed lentils overnight and grind them into a coarse paste without adding too much water.
2. Heat mustard oil in an iron kadhai until it smokes, then add cumin seeds and a pinch of asafoetida.
3. Add the lentil paste to the kadhai and roast it on medium heat until it turns golden brown and aromatic.
4. Stir in ginger-garlic paste, green chilies, turmeric, and coriander powder, cooking for another two minutes.
5. Gradually add hot water, stirring continuously to ensure no lumps are formed, and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the flame to low and let it simmer for 20-30 minutes until the gravy thickens and develops a deep, rich flavor.
7. Serve hot with steamed red rice or rotis.
description: Phaanu is a staple comfort food from the Garhwal region of Uttarakhand. It is highly valued for its high protein content and rustic flavor, often prepared during winter months. Its earthy, slow-cooked texture represents the traditional hill-cooking philosophy of making nutrient-rich meals from basic, locally grown legumes.
